existingChenangoProvider.name: Chenango River Port Crane to Chenango Bridge public paddling access
existingChenangoProvider.method: The current NYSDEC Broome County directory lists the Port Crane DOT Park and Ride and Chenango Bridge Route 12A hand launches. Broome County’s River Guide identifies Port Crane as the alternative start for the distinct Chenango Forks-to-Chenango Bridge itinerary. Both controls are public access-area anchors requiring current field verification; Chenango Bridge is the hard endpoint before the downstream urban dam corridor.
